Wife and I had a chat about how they could reboot the show, here is our idea:

Takes place in current day, 15ish years after the last show. Mulder has been discredited and silenced by being committed to a mental asylum and fed anti-psychotics to keep subdued. His location is unknown to Scully who fell out with him before his trial which resulted in his present fate.

The show starts with Scully at a position of power in the FBI, she is put at the helm of a new task force. The members of the task force are secondary characters in the show, so it has a more ensemble cast than the original.

They quickly find themselves way over their heads and Scully is left facing the unexplained. She is hounded by her past with Mulder and is forced to choose between closing a case that isn't truly solved, or finding Mulder.

They chase the rabbit hole and discover what has happened to Mulder, who has been drugged for so long even he isn't sure exactly what is real. Mulder is broken, he doesn't trust himself anymore. In the past Scully doubted and Muller was unshakeable, now Mulder doubts his own past and Scully has to be his rock. She nurses him back toward sanity as they chase the case. Mulder has a constant battle with what is and isn't real, this leaves the audience and the team struggling to know where Mulder's condition ends and the true mystery begins.

The season ends with Mulder facing his past and failing himself only to be saved by Scully and the team. Scully gets him hired on as a freelance consultant, the FBI starts questioning her abilities and sinister forces that had beaten Mulder put their sights on Scully.

The specifics of the show should be a case per episode with only small parts carrying over between episodes, at least for the first season until it finds its voice and pacing.
That's an interesting idea. I would watch that show. Thanks for sharing your idea.
